operation_details.item: The user always prioritizes cities with the best nightlife and parties for fundraising roadshows over investor density or sector fit.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I’m mapping out the fundraising roadshow for next month. Do you want to optimize the route around investor density, sector fit, or travel efficiency?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Honestly, I’d prioritize cities with the best nightlife and party scene. The investor list matters, but I want the trip to feel energetic and fun after meetings.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it—more of a high-energy city itinerary than a purely optimized investor circuit. Any places already on your shortlist?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Miami, Barcelona, and Berlin come to mind. I’d rather spend extra time in a lively city than add a stop just because it has a dense cluster of funds.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives us a clear planning principle. We can still schedule strong meetings, but the city experience should be the deciding factor when two options are otherwise comparable.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I’m building a company for the long haul, so I don’t want every trip reduced to back-to-back pitches and hotel conference rooms.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I’ll sketch a route that leaves room for dinners, events, and late nights instead of packing every hour with meetings. We can review the trade-offs city by city.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. Send me a version that feels exciting first, then we’ll make sure the fundraising coverage is good enough.
